name: plugins-for-claude-natives
title_zh: 给重度用户的 Claude Code 插件合集
tagline_zh: 不用再自己拼插件：一套装好，覆盖日常高频操作。适合已经离不开 Claude Code、想省下配置时间的人。
tagline_en: Skip plugin hunting: a curated set for daily workflows. For those who live in Claude Code and want less setup time.
desc_en: Claude Code plugins for power users
why_zh: 不是零散插件堆砌，而是按真实工作流精选组合，装完即用，省去逐个筛选和调试的麻烦。
why_en: Not a random list, but a workflow-focused selection that works out of the box, saving you from trial and error.
limit_zh: 仅适用于 Claude Code 环境，需自行安装配置；不含插件源码修改，超出预设场景需自行扩展。
limit_en: Only for Claude Code; requires manual install. No source mods; beyond preset use, extend yourself.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Claude Code plugin pack for power users
